Given your daycare attendance, have you or anyone close to you recently been exposed to a chickenpox outbreak, and do you recall having chickenpox as a child?

speaker: Doctor

The normal readings do not rule out the clinical picture. Has anyone in your household or daycare been diagnosed with chickenpox or shingles recently, and do you remember having chickenpox as a child?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Varicella (Chickenpox).

The clinical history of multiple skin lesions, daycare exposure, and lack of prior immunity is classic for a primary Varicella-Zoster infection, even if initial serology was read as normal (which can occur in false negatives or specific assay limitations). The distribution and morphology of the lesions are consistent with this viral exanthem.
